neighbours.label: a token inside the definition of a unit of measurement (one watt equals, a carat is a unit for, BTU - the amount of heat)
fire: One horsepower equals 746 watts, or about 550 foot-pounds per second.
A hectare is a unit of area equal to 10,000 square meters.
Calorie (cal) — The amount of energy that heats one gram of water.
One nautical mile equals 1.852 kilometers by international agreement.
A knot is a unit of speed used by ships and aircraft.
One gallon of water is equal to about 3.785 liters.
A light-year is the distance that light travels in one year.
quiet: One neighbor owns six horses, or about half of the valley.
A hedge is a row of bushes along the edge of the field.
Calvin (Cal) — The name of the youngest son in that family.
One old mile marker stands near the road by the farm.
A knot is a tangle in the rope used by the sailors.
Kim Park (KP) — A friend of the family from Seoul.
One glass of water is on the table by the door.
A lighthouse is the place where the old keeper lives.

notes: Card: digits, ' of', ' the', ' a', ' large', ' (' with unit definitions (BTU, watt, carat, megawatt, gallon, 'million, billion'). Probes: 'equals 1/746' 0.912, 'a carat is a' 0.841, BTU 0.419, Megawatt 0.398; 'One farmer owns' 0.009, 'A cat is a pet' 0.007. The peak can be a digit, article or a word, so the context is what counts. New units are in the test, and near misses keep the 'X is a Y' frames.
